text:
A precision ranged fighter who manages focus to fire powerful shots.

Primary: DEX | Secondary: WIS

MP mechanic: MP regenerates passively from DEX+WIS+gear - all bow skills and spells cost MP. Run out of focus and your shots fail.

Skills:
Bow Assail - basic bow attack
Arrowstep - 2-tile dash

Spells:
Arrow Shot - basic ranged auto-attack
Fire Shot - fire damage
Deadcenter - massive precision shot, 3 cast lines, lock-on visual
Trapper's Net - slow with net animation
Rain of Arrows - 5-volley area bombardment
Flechette - chain bounce 3 targets
Precise Shot - heavy single target
Focus - self buff, accuracy + damage
